description: This PHP file defines a migration class for upgrading a database schema within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for modifying buzz-related tables, handling time zone conversions, and managing foreign key constraints during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class for performing specific database schema migrations related to the Buzz feature set in OrangeHRM, including timezone conversions, table modifications, and foreign key management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the upgrade/migration operations, such as inserting permissions, updating language strings, modifying tables, and cleaning up configuration values.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to a specific version.

methods.name: createColumnToStoreBuzzOriginalVideoLink
methods.description: Adds a new column to store original video links within the buzz link table, and populates it based on existing post text.

methods.name: modifyBuzzTables
methods.description: Drops unwanted tables/columns, modifies character set, manages foreign keys, and alters columns for buzz-related tables.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys that conflict with the current schema, specifically those referencing 'hs_hr_employee'.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops conflicting foreign key constraints to resolve schema issues.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Restores foreign keys that were previously dropped, ensuring referential integrity after modifications.

methods.name: changeBuzzTablesDateTimeColumnsAsNotNull
methods.description: Alters buzz-related datetime columns to be NOT NULL.

methods.name: convertBuzzCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts comment time fields in the buzz comment table to UTC timezone.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the buzz like on comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the buzz like on share table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzPostTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts post time fields in the buzz post table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts share time fields in the buzz share table to UTC.

methods.name: getTableRecordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of records in a specified table, used for batch processing.

methods.name: convertServerTimeToUTCTime
methods.description: Converts a given DateTime object from server time to UTC.

methods.name: getUTCTimeZone
methods.description: Returns a DateTimeZone object set to UTC.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns a helper object for managing language strings.
